description.value: Sunshine Coast Olive Oil Co. is an independent, family-owned gourmet food store in Gibsons specializing in award-winning single-estate and infused extra virgin olive oils and balsamic vinegars sourced with full farm-to-table traceability through direct farmer relationships. The shop carries oils certified to the Ultra Premium (UP) standard—the highest tier within the extra virgin category—alongside specialty groceries including crackers, olives, spreads, gourmet pasta, and condiments from BC, Greece, Italy, and Spain. It also operates an online store with in-store pickup, making it a distinctive artisan provisions stop on the Sunshine Coast.
